sections.title: Advanced 3-D Modeling
sections.description: Advanced 3-D Modeling will give students the opportunity to refind skills in modeling, texturing, lighting and rendering with an emphasis on the evolution of ideas through constant revision based class critique. Students will use a variety of industry standard software packages, including but not limited to Maya and Mudbox to compose complex environments. Projects are designed to give students the opportunity to work with orginial content within a simulated production environment.
